saints.name: The Seven Holy Founders of the Servite Order
saints.title: Founders
saints.shortBlurb: Seven noblemen of Florence who left the world together to serve Our Lady of Sorrows and founded the Order of Servites…
biography: In the year 1233 seven prosperous merchants and noblemen of Florence, moved by devotion to the Mother of God, withdrew from the world and gave themselves to penance and prayer. Retiring to Monte Senario near the city, they formed a community devoted to the sorrows of the Blessed Virgin, and so began the Order of the Servants of Mary, the Servites.
The order spread through Italy and beyond in their lifetimes and after. The seven founders were canonized together in 1888 by Pope Leo XIII and are honored on a single day.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Order of Servants of Mary (Servites).

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 11 February
